solutionLabel.zh: 文档、标书与方案自动化

profile.zh: 某专业咨询与投研机构，方案与尽调报告撰写量大、引用与论证要求严格。
profile.en: A consulting and investment research firm producing high volumes of evidence‑based proposals and due‑diligence memos.

background.zh: 该机构每月需交付大量项目建议书与行业尽调备忘录。过往分析报告、政策文件与财务模型分散在不同目录，撰写人员需要花费大量时间翻找旧稿、核对技术参数与检查章节遗漏。
background.en: Analysts prepare dozens of client proposals and investment memos each month. Historical reports, regulatory filings and financial assumptions lived in separate folders, forcing teams to spend days locating references and cross‑checking figures.

challenges.zh: 历史方案、行业政策与成本模型分散存放，新项目难以快速定位有效依据。
challenges.en: Past proposals, regulatory documents and cost models sat in separate repositories with no unified clause search.

challenges.zh: 每份初稿整理与拼写约需两天，商业假设与技术路线容易前后不一致。
challenges.en: Assembling a first draft took roughly two days, and late changes often broke consistency across sections.

challenges.zh: 关键风险提示与必填章节靠人工逐页检查，高峰期审核压力大。
challenges.en: Missing mandatory sections or unstressed financial assumptions had to be caught manually under tight deadlines.

whyNotGeneric.zh: 通用聊天工具无法区分过期项目条件与当前客户约束，也无法按该机构的七项交付标准逐条核验引用出处与关键假设压力测试。
whyNotGeneric.en: A generic chat window cannot separate outdated project assumptions from current client constraints, nor enforce the firm’s seven‑point completeness and citation checklist.

background.zh: 该企业拥有上千篇内部 IT 操作指南，但员工遇到 VPN、邮箱、软件权限或设备申领问题时仍习惯直接提工单，导致一线支持工程师每天重复回答相同问题。
background.en: Despite maintaining over 1,200 internal Wiki articles, employees routinely opened support tickets for VPN setup, email access and software requests, creating long queues for Tier‑1 engineers.

challenges.zh: VPN、权限与设备申请等高频问题占工单大多数，挤占系统建设人力。
challenges.en: Repetitive VPN, access and hardware questions consumed most Tier‑1 support capacity.

challenges.zh: 制度文档更新后旧截图与旧流程仍在流传，员工难以确认现行规定。
challenges.en: Policy updates left outdated instructions circulating, making employees unsure which guide applied.

challenges.zh: 涉及权限审批与异常故障的请求需要完整上下文转交人工，不能盲目作答。
challenges.en: Privilege escalations and network anomalies required clean handoffs to human engineers rather than guesswork.

whyNotGeneric.zh: 内部支持必须严格按员工所属部门与权限检索现行有效制度，并在低置信度或涉及特权审批时自动创建带排查记录的一线工单。
whyNotGeneric.en: Internal IT support requires role‑scoped retrieval over active SOPs, exact article citations and automatic ticket creation when confidence is low or human approval is required.

profile.zh: 某粉体工程装备制造企业，设备型号多、工艺参数复杂、海外与现场咨询频繁。
profile.en: An industrial powder‑processing equipment manufacturer with complex machinery lines and global technical inquiries.

background.zh: 客户在选型时常询问特定物料（如磷酸铁锂、高镍三元材料）的粒径指标、能耗占地与相似产线案例。过去一线销售难以当场答准，需要反复向后端工艺工程师求证。
background.en: Prospective buyers ask detailed questions about particle‑size distributions, energy consumption and comparable plant installations. Field sales previously had to wait on senior process engineers before responding.

challenges.zh: 工艺参数分散在规格书与历史交付档案中，销售在客户现场查找缓慢。
challenges.en: Specifications and past plant records lived across separate engineering files, slowing down field meetings.

challenges.zh: 海外与跨时区线上访客咨询技术细节时，普通客服无法给出专业解答。

challenges.zh: 对外公开问答与内部报价参考需要严格的权限分级，敏感价格不能外泄。
challenges.en: Public prospect Q&A and internal pricing benchmarks needed strict clearance separation.

metaDescription.en: SmartDoc AI Data Query built by Cyano: read‑only PostgreSQL and MySQL connections let business teams query inventory and sales in plain language with full SQL policy guardrails.

model.zh: 低启动试点 + 持续服务

profile.zh: 某零售与供应链运营企业，SKU 数量多，日常库存预警、供应商履约与区域销量查询频繁。
profile.en: A retail and supply‑chain operator managing a large SKU catalog across regional warehouses and vendors.

background.zh: 运营与采购团队每天需要核对各区域销售额、低库存商品与供应商响应时效。由于业务人员不会编写 SQL，过去每次临时看数都要向数据团队提单排期。
background.en: Operations and merchandising teams needed daily answers on regional sales, low‑stock SKUs and vendor SLAs, but every ad‑hoc question required filing a ticket for an analyst to write SQL.

challenges.zh: 常规临时查数需求排队一天以上，错过库存补货与促销调整窗口。
challenges.en: Routine data requests waited a day or more in the IT queue, delaying restocking decisions.

challenges.zh: 多套业务库字段命名复杂，直接开放数据库既不安全也容易算错口径。
challenges.en: Raw table schemas across ERP, CRM and warehouse databases were too complex and risky to expose directly.

challenges.zh: 企业合规要求严禁写操作与敏感列泄露，每次查询必须保留完整审计记录。
challenges.en: Security rules required strict read‑only execution, PII column masking and full query audit trails.

whyNotGeneric.zh: 业务查数必须绑定双方确认的统一指标语义层，并在执行前通过只读策略门禁（禁止改表、PII 脱敏、行数上限与审计编号记录）。
whyNotGeneric.en: Trusted analytics requires an agreed metric schema map plus a deterministic SQL policy gate enforcing SELECT‑only queries, PII masking, row limits and audit IDs.

condition.en: SELECT‑only, no DDL, PII masking, LIMIT enforcement and audit metadata

afterSummary.zh: 输入一句话问题，系统映射标准指标、通过五重只读门禁校验并秒级返回带审计编号的结果表。
afterSummary.en: Ask in plain language; the system maps agreed schemas, passes 5 SQL policy gates and returns auditable results in seconds.

afterTotalLabel.zh: 秒级只读查询 + SQL 透明可查

业务核对生成的 SQL 口径与审计编号

outcome.zh: 上线后，采购与运营人员可用自然语言直接查询库存、销量与供应商履约数据，常规取数不再依赖 IT 导表队列。
outcome.en: Merchandising and operations teams now query inventory, sales and vendor metrics directly in plain language, removing routine reporting from the IT backlog.

techHighlights.zh: 只读数据库连接与字段级权限映射，从源头杜绝误删改生产表风险。
techHighlights.en: Read‑only PostgreSQL, MySQL and Snowflake connectors with table‑level permission mapping.

techHighlights.zh: 五重策略沙箱（Policy Gate）逐条拦截非 SELECT 语句、未脱敏敏感字段与无上限全表扫描。
techHighlights.en: Deterministic Policy Gate blocks non‑SELECT statements, unmasked PII columns and unbounded scans.

techHighlights.zh: 每行返回结果附带来源编号与完整执行审计日志，生成的 SQL 对审核人完全透明。
techHighlights.en: Every result row carries a citation ID and full SQL audit trail for complete transparency.

profile.zh: 某多套出租物业管理与租赁运营方，日常需协调租客、维修工与多套房产账目。
profile.en: A residential rental and property management operator overseeing multiple leased properties, contractors and owner statements.

background.zh: 管理多套房源时，暖炉检修、水管维修、地税账单与租金流水分散在聊天消息和纸质票据中，月底手工对账耗时且容易漏记支出。
background.en: Across dozens of units, furnace repairs, plumbing invoices, property‑tax bills and rent receipts arrived through scattered chat threads and paper photos, making monthly reconciliation error‑prone.

challenges.zh: 租客报修、维修工报价与完工确认散落在不同消息里，难以与账单对应。

challenges.zh: 地税单、管理费收据需要手工录入金额、日期与归属房源。
challenges.en: Property‑tax and HOA bills had to be keyed into spreadsheets manually per address.

challenges.zh: 屋主希望随时在手机端查看单套物业净收益与年度收支结构。
challenges.en: Property owners wanted clear mobile visibility into per‑unit net income and annual cash flow.

whyNotGeneric.zh: 需要将移动端多角色沟通工单、票据 OCR 识别与房源级财务分类账打通，并在入账前保留运营人员一键核对环节。
whyNotGeneric.en: Requires tying mobile work‑order threads and receipt OCR directly into a property‑scoped ledger with operator confirmation before posting.

detail.en: Built mobile messaging, receipt OCR extraction and property‑scoped ledger views.

phase.zh: 第 6–7 周 · 历史票据与工单实测

detail.zh: 使用真实地税单、维修收据与多房源账目校验提取准确度。
detail.en: Tested extraction accuracy on historical tax statements, contractor invoices and chats.

phase.zh: 第 8 周 · 运营团队与屋主上线

detail.zh: 多套在管房源正式迁入日常使用，按月自动生成屋主对账单。
detail.en: Rolled out across managed properties for daily mobile expense capture and reporting.

title.zh: 可控记忆层与多分支管理，支撑百万字级长篇连载创作
title.en: Controlled memory and branch isolation for million‑word narratives

metaDescription.zh: 某长篇内容创作团队的 DME 写作引擎项目：设计百万字级设定记忆管理、平行剧情分支隔离与多模型切换能力，解决长篇创作前后设定冲突问题。
metaDescription.en: DME Writing Engine built by Cyano: manages million‑word story canon, isolated plot branches and multi‑model routing so long‑form narratives stay consistent.

profile.zh: 某专业长篇小说与影视剧本创作团队，单部作品体量达数十万至百万字。
profile.en: A serialized fiction and scriptwriting studio developing multi‑arc narratives spanning hundreds of thousands to over a million words.

background.zh: 在长篇连载与多线剧本推演中，人物动机、时间线伏笔与世界观规则多达数百条。普通对话窗口一旦超过几十轮就会遗忘早期设定，尝试不同剧情走向时还会把废弃分支的细节混入正稿。
background.en: Long‑running series accumulate hundreds of character constraints, timeline clues and world rules. Standard chat tools forget early canon as chapters grow and bleed discarded plot experiments into the main storyline.

challenges.zh: 百万字级设定资料远超单次模型输入上限，全量塞入既昂贵又容易顾此失彼。
challenges.en: A million‑word story bible cannot fit cleanly into a single prompt without high cost and missed details.

challenges.zh: 推演“冷静谈判”与“行动失控”等不同走向时，平行分支记忆容易互相污染。
challenges.en: Exploring alternate chapter directions caused conventional chat threads to mix up canon across branches.

challenges.zh: 团队希望按章节任务灵活切换云端商业大模型与本地私有模型。
challenges.en: Writers needed to switch seamlessly between frontier cloud models and local private endpoints.

whyNotGeneric.zh: 需要独立的树状分支状态机与可审查的“记忆抽屉”，让作者精确决定哪条伏笔入库、哪个分支生效，而不是任由黑盒上下文随意截断。
whyNotGeneric.en: Requires explicit branch‑isolated state trees and an inspectable memory drawer where authors approve which canon cards enter active context.

label.zh: 设定与归档记忆容量

condition.zh: 指记忆库分层归档管理容量，按当前章节动态装载所需片段
condition.en: Managed archive capacity; loads only chapter‑relevant fragments per request

label.zh: 平行剧情线隔离推演

condition.zh: 各分支拥有独立记忆快照，切换走向互不串设定
condition.en: Separate memory snapshots per branch prevent canon cross‑contamination

label.zh: 主流 API 与私有模型兼容

condition.zh: 同一套设定记忆库可跨不同生成模型复用
condition.en: Story memory and fragments stay portable across cloud and local models

beforeSummary.zh: 手工维护冗长设定文档并反复粘贴提示词，切换剧情走向时经常出现人物前后矛盾。
beforeSummary.en: Manually pasting character sheets into chat windows and untangling contradictions whenever plotlines branched.

afterSummary.zh: 按章节自动装载相关设定卡片，树状切换平行剧情分支，自动提炼新伏笔经作者确认后归档。
afterSummary.en: Relevant canon cards load automatically per scene, branches stay isolated, and new plot hooks enter memory only after author approval.

beforeTotalLabel.zh: 手工粘贴设定 + 频繁修补穿帮

afterTotalLabel.zh: 按需装载记忆抽屉 + 分支零串线
afterTotalLabel.en: Scoped memory drawer + clean branch switch

label.zh: 手工翻找旧章节核对人物细节
复制粘贴长段设定占用上下文
label.en: Paste bulky lore notes every session

label.zh: 排查并返工前后穿帮的剧情段落
label.en: Rewrite scenes broken by canon drift

label.zh: 记忆引擎按分支与场景动态装载设定
主创确认新伏笔卡片并选定正稿分支
label.en: Author approves memory cards & canon branch

outcome.zh: 上线后，创作团队可在平行分支中自由推演不同剧情走向而不污染正稿设定，长篇连载中的人物底线与伏笔回收保持前后一致。
outcome.en: Writers now test alternate chapter arcs without polluting main‑line canon, keeping character rules and foreshadowed clues consistent across long‑form serials.

techHighlights.zh: 可视化的记忆抽屉与碎片库，每条人物性格、关键谎言与伏笔均可独立查看、编辑与启停。
techHighlights.en: Inspectable memory drawer and fragment library where every character rule and clue can be toggled or edited.

techHighlights.zh: 树状会话分支快照（如 1/2 与 2/2 走向对比），切换分支时同步切换对应的上下文状态。
techHighlights.en: Tree‑structured branch snapshots switch active memory state cleanly alongside conversation turns.

techHighlights.zh: 模型无关的连接层与打包归档机制，支持将整部作品的设定包导出备份或切换底层模型。
techHighlights.en: Model‑agnostic connector layer and portable archive packs decouple story memory from any single LLM.

caption.zh: 多分支推演主界面：对比“分支 B：行动失控线（2/2）”，自动提炼人物底线与关键伏笔为待入库记忆卡片。
caption.en: Branch comparison workspace evaluating Branch B (2/2) and proposing structured character and plot‑hook memory cards.

caption.zh: 会话记忆抽屉：展示当前章节已装载的人物设定、地点规则与生效状态。
caption.en: Active memory drawer inspecting character profiles, location rules and pinned constraints for the scene.

caption.zh: 上下文与记忆计量面板：实时监控各层级记忆占用的 Token 预算与命中情况。
caption.en: Context and memory telemetry view tracking token allocation across active and archived memory tiers.

caption.zh: 沉浸式正文编辑器与 AI 辅助侧栏：边写正稿边调用已验证的世界观设定。
caption.en: Manuscript editor paired with the context‑aware AI assistant panel.

caption.zh: 设定碎片库批量管理：按人物、章节与标签筛选、合并或归档大量设定条目。
caption.en: Fragment library supporting bulk filtering, tagging and curation across hundreds of lore entries.

caption.zh: 归档包检查器：查看长篇作品阶段性记忆快照包的结构与版本记录。
caption.en: Archive pack inspector verifying versioned story‑bible snapshots.

caption.zh: 多模型连接配置：统一管理主流云端模型 API 与本地私有推理端点。
caption.en: Multi‑model connection settings configuring cloud APIs and local private inference endpoints.

caption.zh: 引擎启动与本地记忆索引初始化界面。
caption.en: Engine initialization loading workspace indexes and memory stores.

title.zh: 单次会话独立设定抽屉

detail.zh: 顶部明确指示当前会话绑定的独立设定集，点击即可展开核查生效条目。
detail.en: Displays active session memory scope with one‑click inspection of loaded canon rules.

title.zh: 实时记忆容量与预算监控

detail.zh: 实时显示当前装载记忆与总归档容量，避免无效历史撑爆上下文窗口。
detail.en: Tracks active memory tokens against total archive capacity so prompts stay lean.

title.zh: 平行剧情分支对比与切换（2/2）

detail.zh: 在同一节点对比“冷静谈判”与“行动失控”两条走向及其悬疑利弊，互不串线。
detail.en: Switches cleanly between alternate plot branches (1/2 vs. 2/2) with isolated state.

title.zh: 待主创确认的伏笔记忆卡片建议

detail.zh: 自动将人物底线与第三章待回收伏笔整理为结构化卡片，经作者确认后才写入记忆库。
detail.en: Proposes structured character‑rule and foreshadowing cards that enter canon only when approved.

title.zh: 人物小传、世界规则与章节归档

detail.zh: 将长篇设定拆分为带标签的结构化记忆碎片与阶段归档包。
detail.en: Organizes character rules, timeline facts and chapter history into tagged fragments.

title.zh: 按当前出场人物与分支装配上下文

detail.zh: 只把当前场景涉及的人物底线与有效分支状态装入模型预算。
detail.en: Loads only active‑branch state and scene‑relevant character cards into the prompt.

title.zh: 跨模型生成走向并提取新伏笔

detail.zh: 支持切换不同模型推演多个章节方案，并自动摘出新增剧情事实。
detail.en: Evaluates alternate plot arcs across chosen models and surfaces new canon candidates.

title.zh: 作者拍板正稿分支与入库设定

detail.zh: 由主创人员决定采纳哪条分支及哪些伏笔卡片正式写入长期记忆。
detail.en: Lead writer approves which storyline branch and memory cards commit to long‑term canon.

phase.zh: 第 1–2 周 · 长篇创作痛点与记忆建模

detail.zh: 与编剧及作者梳理设定分类、分支回滚逻辑与人工确认节点。
detail.en: Defined fragment schemas, branch isolation rules and author approval workflows.

phase.zh: 第 3–6 周 · 记忆抽屉与分支引擎开发

detail.zh: 实现树状会话分支、动态上下文预算统计、碎片库与归档包机制。
detail.en: Built tree‑branch state, live token telemetry, bulk fragment management and archive packs.

phase.zh: 第 7–8 周 · 多模型接入与长卷压测

detail.zh: 接入主流云端与私有模型端点，用数十万字连载样本测试设定召回一致性。
detail.en: Integrated cloud and private LLM endpoints and tested recall across multi‑volume drafts.

phase.zh: 第 9–10 周 · 编辑器整合与交付上线

detail.zh: 完善正文编辑器联动交互并交付创作团队日常连载使用。
detail.en: Delivered the integrated note editor and memory suite to the writing team.
